stuck.title: The board is stuck
stuck.body: A crate a goal was waiting for has gone into a pit. Only a reset gets it back.
results.title: SOLVED
setup.title: BOX DEPOT
howto.1.title: Push
howto.1.body: Walk into a crate to push it. You can only push, never pull — so think before you shove.
howto.2.title: Match the colours
howto.2.body: Every crate has to finish on a mark of its own colour, and a pit keeps whatever falls in.
howto.3.title: Undo
howto.3.body: The action button takes the last move back, one step at a time. Or reset the board and start over.
howto.4.title: Co-op
howto.4.body: Some depots put two workers on the floor at once, each on their own controller.
